propositions: unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry carries a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys when forward entries lack jira_key or are deleted out-of-band
reverse entries that survive forward-entry deletion are reported indefinitely by fsck as store_integrity faults, masking genuine future problems behind a constant non-zero orphan count

concurrent merge conflicts with merge=ours strategy on bindings.json can drop forward entries wholesale while leaving their corresponding reverse entries, producing permanent orphaned keys with no public API to clean them up
fix 1 makes unbind() self-contained by sweeping the reverse index for any residual key pointing at local_id, ensuring cleanup regardless of forward entry contents
fix 2 adds bridge fsck --repair to prune orphaned reverse bindings via guarded deletion (only reverse_missing_forward kinds, no retired keys, no concurrent forward rebinds, idempotent save)
the repair delegates to BindingStore.unbind() per orphan rather than raw _data access, preserving module size and public API boundaries
